name: Rockefeller Opportunistic Municipal Bond ETF
desc: The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks current income exempt from federal income tax and seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing in municipal bonds. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in debt securities whose interest is, in the opinion of bond counsel for the issuer at the time of issuance and under current tax law, exempt from federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
